## Detailed Professional Biography
Hamza Ahmed Shaikh is a Full Stack Web Developer and MERN Stack Engineer known under the personal brand Hamzario. Based in Karachi, Pakistan, Hamza has spent over four years crafting high-performance, accessible, and scalable web applications for businesses, startups, and clients around the world.

Hamza holds the Meta Front-End Developer Professional Certificate from Coursera, demonstrating verified mastery in modern JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3, React, responsive UI engineering, and web accessibility standards. Combining front-end artistry with robust backend development (Node.js, Express, MongoDB), Hamza builds end-to-end software solutions ranging from custom SaaS products to e-commerce marketplaces and interactive games.

## Complete Skill Matrix
- **Frontend**: React.js, Next.js (App Router, Server Components, Static Export), JavaScript (ES6, ES7, ES8+), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap 5, HTML5 Semantic Markup, CSS3 Flexbox & Grid, CSS Animations, Ionicons, Mobile-First Responsive Design.
- **Backend**: Node.js runtime, Express.js framework, REST API design and documentation, JWT Authentication, Cookie and Session Management, Asynchronous JavaScript, Middleware design.
- **Databases**: MongoDB, Mongoose ODM, NoSQL schema modeling, queries, data aggregation.
- **E-Commerce**: Shopify Theme Development, Liquid templating language, Custom product templates, Payment gateway and shipping configuration.
- **Tooling & Architecture**: Git version control, GitHub Actions automated CI/CD deployment, GitHub Pages static hosting, Vercel edge deployment, npm package ecosystem.
- **Search Engine & AI Optimization (SEO / GEO / LLM)**: Semantic HTML, Schema.org Knowledge Graph (Person, WebSite, ProfessionalService, ItemList, FAQPage), Open Graph protocols, Twitter Card metadata, Geo-targeting coordinates (PK-SD / Karachi), PWA Manifest, llms.txt integration.
